messages:
ana_partnerships: Quick sync — we need a firm go/no‑go for the cross-cloud connector pilot (Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant) and marketplace listing. Targeting a joint announcement + marketplace listing the week after next. Can folks confirm owners for: certification checklist, E2E test harness, marketplace assets, SI runbook?

mike_gtm: I can take marketplace assets + PR draft. Need partner logos, headshots, and a 1‑par customer quote (if we can get one). ETA for draft: Thu. :thumbsup:

devin_infra: For the E2E test harness I'll own the connector validation and smoke tests. Two things to flag: Snowflake private link creds are flaky on staging, and Delta CDC tests need a stable time‑series workload. I'll run a full run tonight and post results.

harry_field: SI/playbook here — I'll draft the runbook and onboarding slides. Need API keys, SSO config notes, and a sanitized sample dataset for training. Field team can start a 2‑week pilot next month if ops are green.

sophie_prod: Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) Successful end‑to‑end ingest + embedding generation for 1k rows without failures; 2) connector schema migration test passes (no dropped columns); 3) latency SLA for embedding path within 500ms P95 on dedicated capacity; 4) manifest + listing assets ready. Can we agree?

amanda_db_pm: From Databricks side I can coordinate PM signoffs and give access to a test workspace. Also will loop in legal for co-marketing checks.

ana_partnerships: @mike_gtm small note — we need to surface pricing guidance for marketplace listing (free tier vs paid connector). Can you coordinate with finance?

mike_gtm: Yep, I'll sync w/ finance. Also drafting press outline. cc @amanda_db_pm for joint messaging.

devin_infra: Quick test command for visibility (what I'm running):

```
./run_connector_test --source snowflake --sink qdrant --rows 1000 --verify-schema --cdc --delta-cdc-workload
```

Dev note: if private link creds fail, fallback to temporary oauth token mode (see issue). Filing the failure here: https://github.com/redwood/connector-tests/issues/342

marketplace-bot: Listing draft created: https://marketplace.redwood.ai/drafts/rdw-crosscloud-vector-connector — assets placeholder added.

harry_field: Field team request: sample dataset should include mixed file types (pdf, html, csv) and one doc with nested tables. Also need SSO test accounts for Okta + ADFS.

sophie_prod: I'll allocate an eval prompt set and regression checks for quality monitoring. Will also add a small prompt set for hallucination detection on vector retrieval.

ana_partnerships: Good. Timeline recapped: complete E2E tests + SI runbook + marketplace assets by next Tue EOD so we can decide Wed morning. Meeting to confirm go/no‑go: Tue 09:00 PT.

mike_gtm: Sounds good. I'll have the PR draft and pricing guidance by Tue morning.

devin_infra: Tests start now; I'll post results to this thread. If anyone hits the Snowflake private link issue ping me directly.

amanda_db_pm: I'll schedule a quick sync with Databricks PMs for Mon. Thanks all.

ana_partnerships: Thanks team — please add any blockers here. :rocket:
